traits.name: Brave
traits.text: Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Frightened condition.

traits.name: Halfling Nimbleness
traits.text: You can move through the space of any creature that is a size larger than you.

traits.name: Luck
traits.text: When you roll a 1 on the d20 of a D20 Test, you can reroll the die, and you must use the new roll.

traits.name: Naturally Stealthy
traits.text: You can take the Hide action even when you are obscured only by a creature at least one size larger than you.

features.name: Expertise
features.text: Choose two skill proficiencies: your Proficiency Bonus is doubled for checks with them.

features.name: Sneak Attack
features.text: Once per turn, deal extra damage to one creature you hit with a Finesse or Ranged weapon if you have Advantage on the roll.

features.name: Thieves’ Cant
features.text: You know the secret mix of dialect, jargon and code of thieves.

features.name: Weapon Mastery
features.text: You can use the mastery properties of two kinds of weapons of your choice.

features.name: Cunning Action
features.text: Bonus Action: Dash, Disengage or Hide.

features.name: Steady Aim
features.text: Bonus Action: Advantage on your next attack roll this turn, if you have not moved. Your Speed is 0 until the end of the turn.

features.name: Fast Hands
features.text: Bonus Action: Sleight of Hand, use Thieves’ Tools, or take the Utilize action.

features.name: Second-Story Work
features.text: You gain a Climb Speed equal to your Speed.

features.name: Fighting Style
features.text: You gain a Fighting Style feat of your choice.

features.name: Second Wind
features.text: Bonus Action: regain Hit Points equal to 1d10 plus your Fighter level.

features.name: Weapon Mastery
features.text: You can use the mastery properties of three kinds of weapons of your choice.

features.name: Action Surge
features.text: On your turn, take one additional action. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Tactical Mind
features.text: When you fail an ability check, spend a use of Second Wind to add 1d10 to the roll.

features.name: Combat Superiority
features.text: You learn maneuvers fuelled by Superiority Dice (four d8s).

features.name: Student of War
features.text: You gain proficiency with one type of Artisan’s Tools and one skill from the Fighter list.

actions.name: Sneak Attack
actions.text: Once per turn, deal an extra 2d6 damage to one creature you hit with a Finesse or Ranged weapon if you have Advantage on the roll.

actions.name: Cunning Action
actions.text: Bonus Action: Dash, Disengage or Hide.

actions.name: Steady Aim
actions.text: Bonus Action: Advantage on your next attack roll this turn, if you have not moved.

actions.name: Second Wind
actions.text: Bonus Action: regain 1d10 + your Fighter level Hit Points.

actions.name: Action Surge
actions.text: Take one additional action on your turn.

actions.name: Tactical Mind
actions.text: When you fail an ability check, spend a Second Wind use to add 1d10.

actions.name: Superiority Dice
actions.text: Four d8 Superiority Dice fuel your maneuvers. All come back on a short or long rest.

actions.name: Maneuver: Precision Attack
actions.text: When you miss with an attack roll, expend a Superiority Die and add it to the roll.

actions.name: Maneuver: Menacing Attack (Dex.)
actions.text: When you hit, expend a Superiority Die and add it to the damage; the target makes a Wisdom save or is Frightened.

actions.name: Maneuver: Commanding Presence
actions.text: Add a Superiority Die to a Charisma (Intimidation, Performance or Persuasion) check.

actions.name: Vex (Shortbow)
actions.text: Vex. If you hit with a Shortbow and deal damage, you have Advantage on your next attack roll against that creature before the end of your next turn.

actions.name: Vex (Shortsword)
actions.text: Vex. If you hit with a Shortsword and deal damage, you have Advantage on your next attack roll against that creature before the end of your next turn.

actions.name: Nick (Dagger)
actions.text: Nick. The extra attack of the Light property can be made as part of the Attack action.

inventory.name: Leather
inventory.text: The breastplate and shoulder protectors of this armor are made of leather that has been stiffened by being boiled in oil. The rest of the armor is made of softer and more flexible materials.

inventory.name: Shortbow
inventory.text: Proficiency with a Shortbow allows you to add your proficiency bonus to the attack roll for any attack you make with it.

inventory.name: Quiver
inventory.text: A Quiver holds up to 20 Arrows.

inventory.name: Arrows
inventory.text: Ammunition for a bow. Each attack expends one.

inventory.name: Potion of Healing
inventory.text: This potion is a magic item. As a Bonus Action, you can drink it or administer it to another creature within 5 feet of yourself. The creature that drinks the magical red fluid in this vial regains 2d4 + 2 Hit Points.

inventory.text: A Backpack holds up to 30 pounds within 1 cubic foot. It can also serve as a saddlebag.

inventory.name: Rations
inventory.text: Rations consist of travel-ready food, including jerky, dried fruit, hardtack, and nuts. See “Malnutrition” for the risks of not eating.

inventory.name: Waterskin
inventory.text: A Waterskin holds up to 4 pints. If you don’t drink sufficient water, you risk dehydration.

maneuvers.name: Precision Attack
maneuvers.text: When you miss with an attack roll, you can expend one Superiority Die and add it to the attack roll, potentially causing it to hit.

maneuvers.name: Menacing Attack
maneuvers.text: When you hit a creature with an attack roll, you can expend one Superiority Die to add it to the damage; the target makes a Wisdom save or is Frightened until the end of your next turn.

maneuvers.name: Commanding Presence
maneuvers.text: When you make a Charisma (Intimidation, Performance or Persuasion) check, you can expend one Superiority Die and add it to the check.

feats.name: Archery
feats.text:
Fighting Style Feat (Prerequisite: Fighting Style Feature)

You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls you make with Ranged weapons.

feats.name: Weapon Mastery

feats.name: Savage Attacker
feats.text:
Origin Feat

You’ve trained to deal particularly damaging strikes. Once per turn when you hit a target with a weapon, you can roll the weapon’s damage dice twice and use either roll against the target.

feats.name: Soldier Ability Score Improvements
feats.text: The Soldier Background allows you to choose between Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution. Increase one of these scores by 2 and another one by 1, or increase all three by 1. None of these increases can raise a score above 20.
